name: Create Garnished
description: Create Garnished is a big food-and-decor addon.

pages.title: Create Garnished
pages.text:
**Create Garnished** is a big food-and-decor addon. It adds nine nuts, glazes and coatings, and many Create-style recipes with fans and [#](7A3C9A)[haunting](entry://glossary/haunting)[#]().\
\
It also has a large set of coloured building stones.

pages.title: Nuts
pages.text: Pecan, almond, cashew, walnut, peanut, chestnut, hazelnut, pistachio and macadamia. They are crushed to cracked nuts, then coated, sweetened or honeyed.

Coating is mostly Create processing. A Deployer applies cinder flour to a nut, and [#](7A3C9A)[compacting](entry://glossary/compacting)[#]() adds effects such as strength to a cinder-coated nut. Garnish Compound and Liquid Garnish finish dishes.\
\
Check [#](7A3C9A)[JEI](entry://glossary/jei)[#]() for each nut's route.

Garnished adds fan recipes in two directions:

- Fans behind coloured **Liquefied Mastic Resin** bulk-dye items in 16 colours.
- A fan behind powdered snow does bulk freezing.

[#](2E5AAC)[Fans](entry://create_basics/fans)[#]() explains how [#](7A3C9A)[fan catalysts](entry://glossary/fan_catalyst)[#]() work.

pages.title: Garnish Compound
pages.text: A key ingredient in finishing dishes. About 47 Garnished recipes run in the Farmer's Delight cooking pot, so the pot is where many Garnished meals end up.

Garnished also adds many haunting recipes: amethyst shards into amber remnant, ender jelly into cosmic powder, crestfallen flora into dragon breath. Zultanite and other cut stones come in many colours for building.\
\
[#](2E5AAC)[Farmer's Delight](entry://food/farmers_delight)[#]() covers the pot.
